posts.notes: Scheduled automation (/orl-publish --fire) failed to actually fire on 09-08: found two bugs, (1) both scheduled tasks pointed at bare 'claude' which Task Scheduler couldn't resolve -- fixed, (2) the standalone claude.exe CLI's OAuth login had expired -- fixed with an API key. Published manually instead, roughly 11 hours after the intended 00:00 slot. DO NOT mark 00:00 as tried in timing-intelligence/state.json based on this entry -- the actual post time diverged too far from the assigned slot to say anything about how 00:00 itself performs. Checked late (09-10, ~2 days after posting, not the usual same-day-later reading) because /orl-timing --log-previous had no working browser mechanism until linkedin-bot.py was built.

posts.notes: Scheduled ORL-Fire ran at 00:30 (Task Scheduler exit 0) but did nothing -- root cause was a stale OAuth credential file (~/.claude/.credentials.json) blocking claude.exe from ever falling back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in headless mode, compounded by insufficient API balance underneath that. Both fixed (credential file renamed to .bak, balance topped up). Fired manually via /orl-publish --fire run directly in an interactive session instead of retrying the scheduled task, roughly 21.5 hours after the intended 00:30 slot -- DO NOT mark 00:30 as tried in timing-intelligence/state.json based on this entry, same reasoning as the 09-08 entry (actual post time too far from assigned slot). linkedin-bot.py --post again exited 1 on the 'Post successful' toast check (same known false-negative as the 09-11 case-study post) but a direct Playwright read of the published-posts page confirmed the post is live with matching text, timestamped 'now' at post time.
